name: @malte.muth/poker-hands-wasm
description: Texas Hold'em hand ranking and exact odds, compiled from Rust to WebAssembly, for Node.js and browsers

scripts.test: sh scripts/with-rustup.sh cargo test && node --test test/*.test.js
scripts.lint: sh scripts/with-rustup.sh cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings && sh scripts/with-rustup.sh cargo clippy --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && sh scripts/with-rustup.sh cargo fmt --check

author: Malte Muth
